It was dated forty-one years earlier and addressed to whoever might find it. The writer described a fishing boat named Marian, a storm off the eastern shoals, and a promise to meet again at the lighthouse. He folded the letter carefully and placed it in the lamp room, beside the logbook.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一条沉默的河。路灯一盏接一盏地亮着，映在湿漉漉的柏油路上，泛出淡淡的橙黄。高楼的窗户大多已经黑了，只有零星几扇还亮着灯，像是有人在无眠中守候。早点摊还没有开张，蒸笼静静地放在角落。环卫工人推着车缓缓走过，扫帚划过地面，发出轻微的沙沙声。远处传来一两声车鸣，很快又被夜色吞没。天边还看不见光，但空气里已经有了一丝微凉，预示着黎明即将到来。", "w03": "- Recursion means a function solves a problem by calling itself.\n- Each call works on a smaller piece until it reaches a simple case that needs no more calls.\n- Then the answers come back up, one layer at a time, until the whole problem is solved."}
